content: Medications within the same class are grouped together. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans allows you to access specific details. The information provided here is intended solely for general informational and educational purposes. It is important to note that individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, you should contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
